_comment: attract —— 3 英文边界 / 3 现有中文义项。raw=2 是**物理义**（引力的吸引），与心理义的 raw=0 只差一个语域标记，但确实是独立概念，判别句成立。
_mergeNote: 3 -> 3。吸引+诱惑 同指 raw=0（attract = draw by allure，中文「诱惑」是这个意思的通俗说法），合并为 s1。

_oldSenses.reason: 对应英文 raw=0 direct toward itself or oneself by means of some psychological or romantic interest。
与「吸引」同指 raw=0 —— attract 的本义就是「以诱惑引起兴趣」，中文「诱惑」是这一义的通俗说法。
对应英文 raw=1 be attractive to —— 形容词性用法（The idea is very attractive.）。

senses.note: direct toward itself or oneself by means of some psychological or romantic interest。线索：attract attention / be attracted to。
be attractive to。系动词用法：sb/sth + attract + adj（The plan attracts me.）。
exert a force on (a body) causing it to approach or prevent it。技术义：opposite poles attract。现有中文无对应，属新增。与 s1 的判别句：She attracted a large crowd. / Opposite magnetic poles attract each other.
